claim_definition: Verifies that the only-gate engine can scan a dependency lockfile and produce a Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) in CycloneDX 1.7 format, correctly classifying each algorithm as quantum-safe or quantum-vulnerable. This is the quantum-readiness audit baseline required before DGV Level 3 upgrade.
scope: Dependency lockfile scanning; CycloneDX CBOM generation; quantum readiness classification
excluded_scope: Runtime binary scanning; transitive dependency graph expansion beyond direct lockfile entries

input.lockfile_content:
[[package]]
name = "sha2"
version = "0.10.8"

[[package]]
name = "ed25519-dalek"
version = "2.1.0"

[[package]]
name = "ring"
version = "0.17.5"

[[package]]
name = "rand"
version = "0.8.5"

test_cases.description: Verifies that a mixed dependency set (quantum-safe sha2/rand + quantum-vulnerable ed25519-dalek/ring) produces a valid CBOM with assessment completed.
